blocks.content: I eat half a banana before I run. Not because I planned it that way — just because it's the thing that made sense one morning and then became the thing I do. My mom would call that a habit. I'd call it not wanting to think about breakfast before I'm fully awake.

Shoes go on left first, then right. My dad showed me that when I was seven and I've done it the same way ever since. I don't know if there's a reason or if the reason is just that I was seven and that's how I learned. I stopped asking questions about it somewhere around fourteen.

Before I left I walked through the apartment once. I do this every morning — not to check anything, I don't forget things — just to see it. The shelf of paints. The brushes in their jars. The sketchbook open on the desk with the pencil still in the crease from last night.
I've thought about why I do that too. I think it's because I like knowing what I'm coming back to.
I locked the door. Went down the stairs.
